checkpoint.title: Route 16 Mail Glitch against Lea & Jed with Blastoise and a Leppa Berry

events.why: Confirm Leppa restores Blizzard PP, then Knock Off against the incoming MIMIEN, Recycle, and finish with Blastoise.
confirm MIMIEN displays the held-item icon (recycled Leppa Berry with Mail Glitch active)

metadata.notes: Ported from the fork's tested PlanData/mg-05.plan.json (Route 16 run on mGBA, 2026-11-23; passed on its third attempt from the save before Lea & Jed). Ends with MIMIEN (Lv 33) holding the recycled Leppa Berry: the Mail Glitch is active. The postconditions check the party order and each slot's held-item mark: CH'DING keeps its own item, Blastoise ate its Leppa Berry, MIMIEN holds the recycled one where its mail was (the C++ run's final party shows the same); verify_mail_glitch reads MIMIEN's mark first.
